submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE was 0.0178% at Sb 0.33, on the Pb-rich side of the Pb2Sb2O7 pyrochlore-like phase. EQE falls off sharply on both sides: 0.0106% at 0.362, 0.0018% at 0.264 and 0.0012% at 0.50. It is almost zero at 0.68 (Sb-rich, PbSb2O6 region). XRD shows the same pyrochlore-like pattern at 0.33 and 0.397, so the change in EQE is not caused by a change of phase.
